No raw Battle.net travel-pass confirmation. Needs pending account invitation identity and acceptance/decline request delivery.
No raw unit-invite confirmation. Needs pending unit identity, acceptance/decline and roster/invitation events.
No raw leave-confirmation mutation. Needs pending leave prompt ownership and confirmed/declined state transition; existing LeaveParty is not prompt confirmation.
No raw request-invite confirmation. Needs pending request identity and accepted/declined delivery, rather than a generic invite call.
No raw raid-to-party mutation. Requires conversion eligibility, excess-member handling and roster-update lifecycle; namespace autostub does not change group state.
No raw party-to-raid mutation. Requires leadership eligibility and coherent raid roster transition/events.
No raw unit-invitation producer. Requires pending invitations, target resolution and eligibility/error events; adding roster members immediately is not an invitation.
No raw outgoing join-request producer. Requires request target/expiry/response state rather than a no-op or immediate roster join.
No raw match-stat column DTO producer. Needs active-match column definitions and ordered statistic metadata; score values alone cannot reconstruct columns.
No raw difficulty-level query. Needs quest-ID metadata and scaling/difficulty rules tied to player/session context; fixed levels would fabricate quest data.
No raw replay-recency query. Needs replay completion timestamps and the native recency boundary, not generic completion flags.
No raw quest triviality predicate. Needs effective quest difficulty and player-level triviality thresholds; quest completion/disabled state is not triviality.
No raw stop-eligibility producer. Needs active session ownership and pending start/stop lifecycle, not a constant based only on session existence.
No raw available-command producer. Needs role/session lifecycle and command enum eligibility; pending-command defaults are not available commands.
No raw session supertracked selection. Needs session-owned selected quest identity and clear/missing semantics distinct from ordinary quest tracking.
No raw joined-state producer. Needs participant acceptance/join state separate from session existence.
No raw command-pending predicate. Needs pending command state and response/clear transitions.
No raw session-start request producer. Needs member consent, pending command and session-created/joined lifecycle; immediate toggling would omit consent.
No raw session-stop request producer. Needs ownership validation, pending stop and destruction/left event lifecycle.
No raw begin-response mutation. Needs pending participant response identity and accepted/declined progression.
No raw supertracked selection mutation. Needs session-owned selection storage and corresponding query/notification lifecycle.
No raw reward-claim mutation. Needs earned activity reward state, eligibility, consumption and entitlement delivery; a no-op would not claim anything.
No raw next-reward claim. Needs ordered unlocked/claimed rewards and eligibility/entitlement transition.
No raw recruitment-link producer. Native token issuance is server-backed; inventing a URL is not a modeled enrollment token.
No raw requirement-text producer. Needs activity requirement metadata and localization inputs, not an arbitrary string.
No raw recruit removal. Needs linked recruit identity and relationship mutation/update events.
No raw asynchronous recruitment refresh. Needs host snapshot/request completion and RAF_INFO_UPDATED delivery, not an empty callback.
No raw social mute-state producer. Voice-chat mute is a different domain; requires account/chat restriction snapshot and transitions.
